info.title: API.SH: Martindale-Hubbell
info.description: The Martindale-Hubbell API from API.SH: public Martindale-Hubbell data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One attorney's Martindale-Hubbell profile: `name`, `position`, `firm`, `isln`, `photo`, `address` and `addresses`, `geo`, practice `phones`, `fax`, `website`, `other_profiles`, `biography`, `practice_areas`, `education`, `credentials` (university, law school, year of first admission, admissions, memberships...), `offers`, `video_call_options`, `ratings` (overall, peer, client, Avvo), `awards` (e.g. AV Preeminent), `profile_visibility`, `peer_reviews` (rating, category scores and every review), `other_directories` (client review summaries elsewhere), `offices`, `updated_at` and `raw`. An unknown attorney answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/martindale-attorney

parameters.name: attorney
parameters.description: Attorney link (https://www.martindale.com/attorney/...-1759372/), its slug, or the numeric id.

get.description:
One law firm office on Martindale-Hubbell: `name`, `address`, `geo`, `phones`, `website`, `logo`, `overview`, `details` (office size, year established, languages, payment...), `practice_areas`, `awards`, `aggregate_rating`, `opening_hours`, `people_count` and `people` (name, title, peer rating, practice areas), `peer_reviews` (with the attorney each review is for), `offices`, `updated_at` and `raw`. get.description:
US law firms on Martindale-Hubbell for a legal issue, practice area or firm name in a place, with the site's filters and sorts. Each firm: `id`, `name`, `url`, `location`, `open_for_business`, `phone`, `website`, `peer_rating`, client and Avvo review scores and counts, and `people` (attorneys shown on the card). `facets` lists each filter's values. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/martindale-firms

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Legal issue, practice area or firm name, e.g. `divorce`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: City and state, e.g. `Seattle, WA` (optional).

parameters.name: practice_area
parameters.description: Practice area as the site lists it, e.g. `Divorce` or `Family Law` (`facets` lists the values for the search). Several: separate with `|`.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City as the site lists it in `facets`, e.g. `Seattle, WA`. Several: separate with `|`.

parameters.name: peer_rating
parameters.description: Peer review rating.

parameters.name: client_rating
parameters.description: Share of clients who recommend.

parameters.name: firm_size
parameters.description: Firm size.

parameters.name: feature
parameters.description: `Open For Business` or `Offers Video Chat` (both: separate with `|`).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language spoken, e.g. `Spanish`. Several: separate with `|`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default: best match).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-500), default 1.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Results per page: 30 (default) or 50.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Peer reviews of an attorney or a law firm on Martindale-Hubbell: overall `peer_rating` and `peer_reviews_count`, the category scores (legal knowledge, analytical capability, judgment, communication, legal experience), and every review (`rating`, `reviewer_position`, `date`, `practice_area`, `text` when written, and for firms the `attorney` reviewed), plus client review summaries from other directories. The site does not show peer reviews from before 2008. Pass `attorney` or `firm`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/martindale-reviews

parameters.name: attorney
parameters.description: Attorney link, slug or numeric id, e.g. `1759372`.

parameters.name: firm
parameters.description: Law firm link (instead of `attorney`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
US attorneys on Martindale-Hubbell (martindale.com) for a legal issue, practice area, lawyer name or law school, in a place, with every filter and sort of the site's results page. Each attorney: `id`, `name`, `url`, `position`, `firm` (name, link, id, office id), `location`, `bio` (short), `photo`, `phone` and `website` (the practice's), `open_for_business`, `offers_video_calls`, `peer_rating` (out of 5), `client_recommended`, `client_reviews_count`, `avvo_rating`, `avvo_reviews_count`. `applied_filters` shows how the site read the search (e.g. `Divorce` as a practice area); `facets` lists each filter's values for this search. `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/martindale-search

get.description:
The site's search box suggestions for some text: practice areas, attorneys, law firms, law schools, locations and legal articles (`groups`, each with `total` and `matches`). With `type=locations`, US cities (or ZIP codes) for the location box.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/martindale-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text typed in the search box, e.g. `divorce` (or a city or ZIP code with `type=locations`).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: `all` (default) or `locations`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
